verdict.rationale: Crossplane is API-first. It extends the Kubernetes control plane, and its core objects (managed resources, composite resource definitions, compositions, and Provider/Function/Configuration packages) are all declarative Kubernetes API resources. The vendor explicitly pitches 'declarative APIs that humans, automation, and AI systems can safely act on' and that are 'machine-readable', and an official CLI covers package build/push, rendering and troubleshooting. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that no UI-only capabilities exist (or that the API is the sole interface), and independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness.
